job_failed.sentence: The job stopped with an error.
job_failed.next: Check its log for the last lines it wrote, fix the cause, and run it again.

oom_killed.sentence: The job ran out of memory.
oom_killed.next: Choose more GPU memory, or a smaller model or batch size, and run it again.

outputs_missing.sentence: The job finished, but didn't save any outputs.
outputs_missing.next: Make sure it writes its results to the outputs folder, then run it again.

outputs_upload_failed.sentence: The job finished, but its outputs couldn't be saved.
outputs_upload_failed.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

host_lost_repeatedly.sentence: It lost its host too many times to carry on. Minutes lost with a host weren't charged.
host_lost_repeatedly.next: Run it again; it starts from its last checkpoint if it saved one.

start_timeout.sentence: The host didn't start it in time.
start_timeout.next: Run it again; you won't be charged for the attempt that failed to start.

offers_exhausted.sentence: No host that fits accepted it.
offers_exhausted.next: Run it again, or raise the most per hour so more hosts fit.

no_candidate.sentence: No host that fits was free.
no_candidate.next: Run it again in a while, or raise the most per hour so more hosts fit.

no_host_for_rematch.sentence: Its host dropped and no other host was free to carry on. Lost minutes weren't charged.
no_host_for_rematch.next: Run it again in a while; it starts from its last checkpoint if it saved one.

insufficient_credit.sentence: There wasn't enough credit to hold for it when a host was found.
insufficient_credit.next: Choose a lower budget, or a lower most per hour in Advanced, and book it again.

credit_exhausted.sentence: Your credit ran out, so it saved a checkpoint and stopped.
credit_exhausted.next: Once you have more credit, run it again; it can start from that checkpoint.

max_spend_reached.sentence: It reached your spending cap, so it saved a checkpoint and stopped.
max_spend_reached.next: Run it again with a higher budget if it needs longer.

operator_stopped.sentence: We stopped it, so you were charged only for the minutes it ran.
operator_stopped.next: If you don't know why, write to us and we'll explain.

renter_cancelled.sentence: You cancelled it before it started.
renter_cancelled.next: Book it again when you're ready.

input_unavailable.sentence: The host couldn't fetch your input, so the job never started.
input_unavailable.next: Check the file is still uploaded, or upload it again, and run it again.

input_unreadable.sentence: The job couldn't read your input.
input_unreadable.next: Check the file isn't damaged and is the kind the template takes, then run it again.

resume_checkpoint_missing.sentence: Its checkpoint couldn't be found to carry on from.
resume_checkpoint_missing.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

storage_failed.sentence: The job couldn't save its work to storage.
storage_failed.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

no_runner.sentence: The host couldn't run this template.
no_runner.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

invalid_start_session.sentence: The host was sent instructions it couldn't follow.
invalid_start_session.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

invalid_args.sentence: The template's settings didn't make sense to the job.
invalid_args.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

invalid_spec.sentence: The template is set up wrongly.
invalid_spec.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

invalid_error_code.sentence: The job failed, and the host didn't say why.
invalid_error_code.next: Check its log for the last lines it wrote, fix the cause, and run it again.

image_pull_failed.sentence: The job's software couldn't be downloaded on the host.
image_pull_failed.next: This was a problem on our side or the host's connection, not yours. Run it again; you weren't charged for the attempt that failed to start.

invalid_input.sentence: The job couldn't use what it was given.
invalid_input.next: Read the last lines of its log, which say what is wrong with your input, fix it, and run it again.

sandbox_not_ready.sentence: The host's safe space wasn't ready to run it.
sandbox_not_ready.next: This was a problem on the host, not yours. Run it again; another host will be tried.

out_of_memory.sentence: The job ran out of memory.
out_of_memory.next: Choose more GPU memory, or a smaller model or batch size, and run it again.

scratch_full.sentence: The job filled its scratch disk.
scratch_full.next: Write less to disk, or delete temporary files as it goes, and run it again.

timed_out.sentence: The job reached the longest time you allowed.
timed_out.next: Run it again with a longer time if it needs it; it can start from its last checkpoint if it saved one.

lease_expired.sentence: The job was stopped because its host lost touch with us.
lease_expired.next: Minutes lost with a host weren't charged. Run it again; it starts from its last checkpoint if it saved one.

runner_failed.next: This was a problem on the host, not yours. Run it again; another host will be tried.

bad_request.sentence: The host couldn't understand the start of the job.
bad_request.next: This was a problem on our side, not yours. Run it again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

unsupported_version.sentence: The host's software is out of date for this job.
unsupported_version.next: This was a problem on the host, not yours. Run it again; another host will be tried.

max_runtime_exceeded.sentence: The job reached the longest time you allowed.
max_runtime_exceeded.next: Run it again with a longer time if it needs it; it can start from its last checkpoint if it saved one.

exit.next: Check its log for the last lines it wrote, fix the cause, and run it again.

unknown.next: Check its log for the last lines it wrote, fix the cause, and run it again.
